run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the preprocess_relaxed script to create LMDB files from trajectory files for the S2EF task
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory files into pickled graph data stored in an LMDB database
run_main_preprocess: run main to chunk trajectory files across workers and extract graph features using AtomsToGraphs
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh 50, radius 6, and edges enabled for feature extraction
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to add custom atom tags, system IDs, and frame IDs to the data object
